notes: Auto-captions (rolling duplicate lines). Names mis-transcribed: 'Long cows'=Longhouse, 'dog'=Dock, 'yearn for it'=Björn's Forage, 'Porks village'=Falkr's Village, 'Wolf Forester'=Ulfr's Forester, 'ghoul/Green Temple'=Gullínn Temple, 'Progen door'=Kongens Dør, 'Corning Hall'=Konungr Hall, 'Voldemar'=Valdemar, 'denver'=Danevirke, 'bond forester'=Bondi Forester, 'draar/dracon'=Drakkar, 'Fishing canard'=Fishing Knarr, 'manaton'=Man-at-Arms (Hirdman). Several techs/landmarks are not named aloud (Sunstones, Farmathr, Hrafn's Raid, Hagl Brodda, Leikr Training, Ríkets Nyckel, Leding) and were mapped by their tooltip wording, which matches the checklist descriptions uniquely. Convention: effectValue = the FIRST number in the tooltip text read aloud; secondary numbers are in unmappedFacts. Chapters covered: learn-page bonuses 00:00-01:41; Dark Age eco, Longhouse, sagas 02:17-08:26; Dark Age military 08:37-10:44; Feudal via Baugr Fort 11:50-14:58; ships 15:29-18:30; Castle (Gullínn Temple, walls, ship techs, Jylland Knight) 19:35-24:17; Imperial (Kongens Dør, University, Hagl Brodda, Leikr) 25:00-30:23; second run for Konungr Hall, Valdemar Castle, Ríkets Nyckel 31:03-35:08. The first run uses a sandbox with fast aging, so ages of techs seen in panels are not trustworthy; tech ages were not filled. Fifteen/fifty caption confusion is a live risk for every 50% value (see Dreki 50 vs 15). Not read in this video: base HP/armor/range/pop of any unit, Hirdman/Shield Maiden/Skâne/Drakkar/Longship cards, Sacred Grove, Folkekirken, Reinforced Keel/Ship Barding, Ulfberht Swords, all research costs/times.
